title: android_system_not_ready · ui_automation_unavailable — emulator restart loop
symptom: uiautomator dump ends with 'Killed' or hangs, and the screen stays on the Google boot logo. adb shell dumpsys activity gives 'Can't find service: activity'; /sdcard gives 'Transport endpoint is not connected'
cause: system_server restarts every few minutes (pidof system_server changes, getprop init.svc.bootanim = running). Seen on a long-running emulator (measured: up 1 day 10 hours · 100 MB free of 2 GB). sys.boot_completed stays 1, so boot looks finished
fix: adb -s <serial> shell getprop init.svc.bootanim — if running, the system is not up yet
After the user confirms, adb -s <serial> reboot (soft reboot, keeps data). Measured: boot finished in 52 s and app run worked
If nothing changes after a few minutes, ask about a cold boot: emulator -avd <AVD> -no-snapshot-load (another session may use it; do not shut it down on your own)
If only ui_automation_unavailable persists, check whether other automation (Maestro · Appium) holds UiAutomation
